name: chart-family
title: Chart family
description: Draws a chart slide (`_class: bar`, `line`, `gantt`, … every member of the chart bucket) from its authored list or table: it dispatches the section to the member's kernel and frames the figure. Each chart fills the family's `kernel` slot from its own manifest; switched off, a chart slide shows the list it was written as.

kernel.description: transformSection(html, ctx) → html | { html, cls } | null: builds one chart section's figure from its first list or table. The member's `kernel` block declares the figure root's class and its data marks; the family dispatches on the first chart class a section carries and wraps the result in the chart frame.
